Asset.description: One output file entry: role-keyed href plus integrity metadata.

href.description: Path to the file, e.g. dem.tif, cl.geojson, or a full s3:// URI.
href.title: Href

checksum.description: First 16 hex of SHA-256 (64-bit). File-integrity checksums; longer than identity hashes to allow cross-corpus content comparison.
checksum.title: Checksum

source_url.description: External provenance URL (DEM/land-cover endpoint, or db_uri). null for purely computed assets.
source_url.title: Source Url

retrieved.description: When the source was fetched, if applicable.
retrieved.title: Retrieved

derived.description: True for outputs regenerable from sources (terrain, roughness); subject to S3 lifecycle deletion.
derived.title: Derived

Asset.title: Asset

Assets.description:
This job's own outputs, written as separate GeoPackage files.

network.gpkg is always present; lakes.gpkg only when lake processing ran.
An absent lakes asset is omitted from serialization entirely (the schema
forbids a null asset entry).

network.description: The modified reach network, written as the reach_network layer — the table name build_model queries through its db_uri.

lakes.description: Filtered + buffered lake polygons actually used for classification (QC/reference only, DR-037 ALT-B). Present only when lake processing ran.

Assets.title: Assets

Identity.description:
The inputs that define Network identity; hashed to identity_hash.

Dataset members follow the _path -> _hash naming rule against inputs.
Threshold members hold the resolved value after defaults are applied.
Nullable members are required-but-nullable: 'no lakes' / 'no coastal' /
'unfiltered' must be stated explicitly, never expressed by omission,
which would otherwise hash differently.

reach_network_hash.description: Hash of the raw hydrofabric network source + version.
reach_network_hash.title: Reach Network Hash

lakes_layer_hash.description: Hash of the lakes source + version. Null when no lakes dataset was supplied and lake processing was skipped.
lakes_layer_hash.title: Lakes Layer Hash

coastal_influence_layer_hash.description: Hash of the coastal/tidal-influence vector source + version. Null when no coastal dataset was supplied and coastal processing was skipped.
coastal_influence_layer_hash.title: Coastal Influence Layer Hash

drainage_area_threshold_percent.description: Max drainage-area difference (%) between reaches eligible for merge (DR-024).
drainage_area_threshold_percent.title: Drainage Area Threshold Percent

stream_order_filter_threshold.description: Minimum Strahler stream order kept in the network at all. Null when no threshold was given and the filter did not run.
stream_order_filter_threshold.title: Stream Order Filter Threshold

min_length_threshold_km.description: Minimum length (km) a reach should reach by merging — a floor, not a ceiling: merging continues until the chain clears it (DR-024).
min_length_threshold_km.title: Min Length Threshold Km

lake_area_threshold_sqkm.description: Minimum lake area (km2) considered at all; smaller waterbodies are dropped before reach classification.
lake_area_threshold_sqkm.title: Lake Area Threshold Sqkm

negative_lake_buffer_meters.description: Inward buffer (m) approximating the dead-pool extent (DR-034 ALT-A).
negative_lake_buffer_meters.title: Negative Lake Buffer Meters

Identity.title: Identity

ModifyNetworkInputs.description:
Inputs for the modify_network workflow.

Defaults resolve at validation, so a manifest records resolved values for
the four defaulted thresholds. stream_order_filter_threshold deliberately
has no default: None means no stream-order filtering at all.

reach_network_path.description: Raw hydrofabric reach network. Must be a GPKG file; column/layer names follow the NHF v1.2.3 flowpaths layer schema.
reach_network_path.title: Reach Network Path

base_output_path.description: Output location for the modified network and manifest; artifacts are written under <base_output_path>/<identity_hash>/.
base_output_path.title: Base Output Path

lakes_layer_path.description: Lakes dataset (NHF v1.2.3 lakes_polygons layer schema). Must be a GPKG file. Omit to skip lake processing entirely.
lakes_layer_path.title: Lakes Layer Path

coastal_influence_layer_path.description: Coastal/tidal-influence surface boundary vector dataset. Must be a GPKG file; default layer name is coastal_influence. Omit to skip coastal processing entirely.
coastal_influence_layer_path.title: Coastal Influence Layer Path

drainage_area_threshold_percent.description: Max drainage-area difference (%) between reaches eligible for merge (DR-024).
drainage_area_threshold_percent.title: Drainage Area Threshold Percent

stream_order_filter_threshold.description: Minimum Strahler stream order kept in the network at all. Omit to skip stream-order filtering entirely — every reach enters processing.
stream_order_filter_threshold.title: Stream Order Filter Threshold

min_length_threshold_km.description: Minimum length (km) a reach should reach by merging — a floor, not a ceiling: merging continues until the chain clears it (DR-024).
min_length_threshold_km.title: Min Length Threshold Km

lake_area_threshold_sqkm.description: Minimum lake area (km2) considered at all; smaller waterbodies are dropped before any reach classification.
lake_area_threshold_sqkm.title: Lake Area Threshold Sqkm

negative_lake_buffer_meters.description: Inward buffer (m) applied to raw lake polygons to approximate the dead-pool extent (DR-034 ALT-A).
negative_lake_buffer_meters.title: Negative Lake Buffer Meters

ModifyNetworkInputs.title: ModifyNetworkInputs

Properties.description:
Reach counters; informational, not part of identity.

Null and 0 are distinct: 0 means the branch ran and matched nothing, null
means the branch did not run. The removal counters are disjoint and must
reconcile (enforced by a validator here — JSON Schema cannot express it):

    n_reaches_output = n_reaches_input
                     - n_reaches_below_stream_order_removed
                     - n_reaches_encompassed_removed_lake
                     - n_reaches_encompassed_removed_coastal
                     - n_reaches_dropped_coastal_cascade
                     - n_reaches_orphaned_lake
                     - n_reaches_merged
                     + n_reaches_split_passthrough_lake

Null terms drop out of the identity. Trim/stranded counters are absent by
design (those reaches keep their rows).

n_reaches_input.description: Rows in reach_network_path as read, before the stream-order filter and any other processing.
n_reaches_input.title: N Reaches Input

n_reaches_below_stream_order_removed.description: Dropped by the stream_order_filter_threshold filter. Null when no threshold was given and the filter did not run.
n_reaches_below_stream_order_removed.title: N Reaches Below Stream Order Removed

n_reaches_encompassed_removed_lake.description: Fully inside a lake polygon — classified as encompassed and dropped. Intermediate classification; leaves no column.
n_reaches_encompassed_removed_lake.title: N Reaches Encompassed Removed Lake

n_reaches_encompassed_removed_coastal.description: Fully inside coastal coverage — classified as encompassed and dropped. Intermediate classification; leaves no column.
n_reaches_encompassed_removed_coastal.title: N Reaches Encompassed Removed Coastal

n_reaches_trimmed_inlet_lake.description: Downstream end inside a lake — trimmed to upstream portion, is_terminal set. Row kept; not in the reconciliation.
n_reaches_trimmed_inlet_lake.title: N Reaches Trimmed Inlet Lake

n_reaches_trimmed_outlet_lake.description: Upstream end inside a lake — trimmed to downstream portion, is_headwater set. Row kept; not in the reconciliation.
n_reaches_trimmed_outlet_lake.title: N Reaches Trimmed Outlet Lake

n_reaches_trimmed_coastal.description: Downstream end inside coastal coverage, upstream not — trimmed, terminal_reason='coast'. Row kept; not in the reconciliation.
n_reaches_trimmed_coastal.title: N Reaches Trimmed Coastal

n_reaches_dropped_coastal_cascade.description: Removed for being downstream of a coastal encompassed/trimmed reach, not for their own classification.
n_reaches_dropped_coastal_cascade.title: N Reaches Dropped Coastal Cascade

n_reaches_stranded_coastal.description: Tributaries left pointing at a cascade-deleted reach — made terminal (terminal_reason='coast'), geometry untouched. Row kept; not in the reconciliation.
n_reaches_stranded_coastal.title: N Reaches Stranded Coastal

n_reaches_split_passthrough_lake.description: Passed through a lake with both ends outside it — split into an inlet/outlet pair, minting a new reach_id (adds one row).
n_reaches_split_passthrough_lake.title: N Reaches Split Passthrough Lake

n_reaches_trimmed_between_lakes.description: Started inside one lake and ended inside another — trimmed at both ends, keeping the dry middle as a channel between the two. Row kept; not in the reconciliation.
n_reaches_trimmed_between_lakes.title: N Reaches Trimmed Between Lakes

n_reaches_orphaned_lake.description: Left with no upstream and no downstream once lake removal took both neighbors, and not an original headwater — the island-stub case. Dropped, so it enters the reconciliation.
n_reaches_orphaned_lake.title: N Reaches Orphaned Lake

n_reaches_merged.description: Consumed by a drainage-area-difference merge into a downstream neighbor.
n_reaches_merged.title: N Reaches Merged

n_reaches_output.description: Rows in the written network.gpkg, after every step including merge.
n_reaches_output.title: N Reaches Output

n_headwater_reaches.description: Rows in the written network.gpkg with is_headwater true — a state of the final artifact, not a count of any one step.
n_headwater_reaches.title: N Headwater Reaches

n_terminal_reaches.description: Rows in the written network.gpkg with is_terminal true — a state of the final artifact, not a count of any one step.
n_terminal_reaches.title: N Terminal Reaches

Properties.title: Properties

description:
modify_network output record: network definition + artifact inventory.

Identity-only variant of the manifest pattern — the job operates on the
whole network in one shot, with no realization axis, so id ==
identity_hash (enforced below).

hash_algo.description: Hash function for every hash/checksum in this document.
hash_algo.title: Hash Algo

created_at.description: Write completion time (UTC). network.json is written last, after network.gpkg/lakes.gpkg.
created_at.title: Created At

id.description: Equal to identity_hash — no realization code to append.
id.title: Id

inputs.description: The modify_network call arguments after default resolution. This is Network's provenance — not part of identity_hash.

warnings.description: Only ambiguous_reach_classification is ever persisted here; network_exists is response-only and never lands in a manifest.
warnings.title: Warnings
